name: McVille Lee Street Camping
note: City of McVille in-town RV lot: grass sites along a dirt lane on the east side of South Lee Street, separate from the city's campground at the dam. Nothing beyond the rates is published; call the city office to confirm it is open and how to pay for a night. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: City of McVille Parks & Recreation page (mcville.com/parks, read 2026-11-12), its own section beside the dam campground: 'Lee Street Camping - Electricity, Water, Sewer & Garbage included - $35.00 Per Day - $200.00 Per Week - $600.00 Per Month - Rent Payable to : City of McVille, Po Box 275, McVille, ND 58254 (or at the City office 113 N. Main St.)', city phone 701-322-4343; ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025) row 67: CITY OF MCVILLE RV PARK, LEE STREET EAST, McVille, Nelson County, owner CITY OF MCVILLE, licence to 12/31/2025, last inspection 8/10/2022, 11 units -> a city RV park named on the town's own page (public ladder step 1; local: no price gate or presence rule). Located on imagery (Wayback 2014-02 release = Microsoft capture 2010-08-09, 0.3 m; Bing aerial z19, undated): the open lot on the east side of South Lee Street (~47.7629-47.7636, -98.1726--98.1723), a dirt lane along its east edge, with ~10 travel trailers parked in a row in 2010 and 3-4 trailers along the lane on Bing -> drive-in grass sites off a paved town street; the parked rigs were 8-12 m long, so a 23-ft rig fits. No 4WD, road or horse wording; no Google Maps listing and no reviews anywhere (gm.py 'Lee Street Camping McVille ND', 'City of McVille RV Park' return only 6027). Long-stay test 4 estimate (no count published): Wayback releases 2018-01 (1 unit), 2019-06/2020-12/2021-09 (same capture, empty), 2022-06/2023-04/2024-03 (same capture, 3 units), 2025-04 and 2026-10 (empty) - at most ~3 of 11 lots occupied in any capture since 2018, so long-term rent holds at most ~30% of the inventory and the daily rate is published first; city wording does not discourage nightly guests -> passes, no caveat band. Separate from 6027 McVille Dam Campground (0.45 km E across the highway): own HHS licence (row 251 MCVILLE CITY CAMPGROUND, HWY 15, City of McVille Park District, 20 units), own section and payment route on the city page (6027 pays at the dam or books on Set Your Sites; 6027's 39 Set Your Sites sites are all at the dam - none named Lee Street), own access off South Lee Street in town.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (900 m frame at 47.7660,-98.1715; 340 m at 47.7632,-98.1712; z19 at 47.7633,-98.1724), Esri Wayback releases 2014-2026 and Bing aerial z19 over 47.7616-47.7640, -98.1732--98.1700. The lot is an in-town grass block between South Lee Street and a dirt lane, bounded by houses to the west and north, two shelterbelt rows to the east and a storage building lot to the south. The nearest water is the McVille Dam reservoir ~400 m east, beyond the shelterbelts, the highway and the dam campground (6027); no water is visible from the lot -> not waterfront.

hookups.note: Electricity at the sites; amperage not published.

hookups_source: https://mcville.com/parks ('Lee Street Camping - Electricity, Water, Sewer & Garbage included'), read 2026-11-12; amperage unpublished, so electric is left absent
sites_source: ND HHS Statewide Licensed RV Parks/Campgrounds (updated 07.17.2025) row 67, CITY OF MCVILLE RV PARK, 11 units; the city page gives no count, read 2026-11-12

fees.note: Weekly $200, monthly $600; electricity, water, sewer and garbage included.

fees_source: https://mcville.com/parks ('$35.00 Per Day - $200.00 Per Week - $600.00 Per Month'), read 2026-11-12

booking.note: No online booking or on-site pay station is published: rent is paid to the City of McVille by mail or at the city office, 113 N Main St.

booking_source: https://mcville.com/parks ('Rent Payable to : City of McVille, Po Box 275, McVille, ND 58254 (or at the City office 113 N. Main St.)'), read 2026-11-12
curation_note: ND lead 28 (2026-11-12): separate from 6027 McVille Dam Campground (0.45 km E; own HHS licence, row 67 CITY OF MCVILLE RV PARK, LEE STREET EAST, 11 units, vs row 251 MCVILLE CITY CAMPGROUND, HWY 15, 20 units). Pin located on imagery from the HHS address, not from any published map. --Claude
flags: Thin evidence: the city page's three-line rate block and the HHS licence are the only sources. No Google listing, no RV Life/Campendium/The Dyrt listing, no reviews; the site count is HHS's, not the city's.

Pin is my imagery read of 'LEE STREET EAST' (HHS): the open lot east of South Lee Street with a dirt lane, where 2010 imagery shows ~10 trailers in a row and Bing shows 3-4. The 2025-04 and 2026-10 Esri captures show it empty - consistent with a lightly used lot, but operation in 2026 rests on the city page still listing the rates.

Long-stay test 4 passes on an estimate: at most ~3 of 11 lots occupied in any capture since 2018, daily rate listed first; no nightly/monthly count exists. The $600 monthly rate and 'Rent payable' wording suggest monthly renters are part of its use.

Phone-list line: McVille Lee Street Camping, City of McVille office 701-322-4343 - is it open in 2026; how a single night is booked and paid (city office hours, any drop box); electric amperage; how many of the 11 lots are on monthly rent; restrooms.
